en: <t1>Liveness is a beat, judged on the local clock.</t1> Each runtime raises its own beat every heartbeat; marks relay beats with how long ago the sender saw them rise. A stream whose beat has not risen within the expiry is expired on that runtime: its sessions are expired and its claims stop excluding. No two machines' wall clocks are compared. Links have their own standing (connecting, connected, degraded, unreachable, expired) with exponential backoff capped at the expiry, and a restarted peer re-handshakes into the same table row.
cs: <t1>Živost je tep posuzovaný na lokálních hodinách.</t1> Každý runtime zvedá vlastní tep každý heartbeat; značky přenášejí tepy s údajem, jak dávno je odesílatel viděl stoupnout. Stream, jehož tep nestoupl do vypršení, je na tomto runtime expirovaný: jeho relace jsou expirované a jeho nároky přestávají vylučovat. Nesrovnávají se hodiny dvou strojů. Spoje mají vlastní stav (connecting, connected, degraded, unreachable, expired) s exponenciálním backoffem omezeným vypršením a restartovaný peer se znovu handshakuje do téhož řádku tabulky.

en: The runtime pack's baseline audit (2026-10-09, M01) read the server and the mesh against their documents and found the security model held only on the network hop. Three servers on the owner's machine were bound that way at the time. Beside it: reloading the journal skips the trust check, so a revoked key's events return on restart; Lamport stamps are not bounded, so a trusted key can backdate a claim to win every conflict; an expired claim revives and wins after a partition; hello messages name no recipient; trust is read from the branch's working tree; discovery inputs have unbounded channels and reply reads.
